headline_marked: EC to announce [[Presidential election schedule soon]]
headline: EC to announce Presidential election schedule soon
summary: Election Commissioner Abdur Rahmannel Mashud says a new president must be elected within 90 days following Md. Sahabuddin's resignation.
details: Election Commissioner Abdur Rahmannel Mashud has announced that the schedule for the presidential election will be declared soon.
Following the resignation of Md. Sahabuddin, the constitution requires a new president to be elected within 90 days.
According to Article 123 of the Constitution and the Presidential Election Act-1991, the process must be completed within this timeframe.
The Election Commission (EC) holds the sole authority to announce the election schedule.
The 350 members of the National Parliament (Jatiya Sangsad) will serve as the voters for the presidential election.
The EC will first prepare the voter list based on the parliamentary members before officially announcing the dates.
caption:
A new president must be elected within 90 days. The Election Commission is preparing to announce the schedule.

Election Commissioner Abdur Rahmannel Mashud has announced that the schedule for the presidential election will be declared soon.

Following the resignation of Md. Sahabuddin, the constitution requires a new president to be elected within 90 days.

According to Article 123 of the Constitution and the Presidential Election Act-1991, the process must be completed within this timeframe.

The Election Commission (EC) holds the sole authority to announce the election schedule.

The 350 members of the National Parliament (Jatiya Sangsad) will serve as the voters for the presidential election.

The EC will first prepare the voter list based on the parliamentary members before officially announcing the dates.
